Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study contains two distinct proteomics experiments: one comparing serum EVs from healthy vs LCC vs RCC (PXD012283), and another comparing the proteome of SW480 cells treated with these different EVs (PXD012304). The 'ligand_stimulation' mapping for the cell line experiment is set to parent-level as EVs are complex mixtures of proteins/lipids rather than a single defined ligand.
